business_problem: Zurich needed to review very large claims volumes more efficiently, reduce investigator drudgery and false positives, and detect fraudulent claims and emerging fraud patterns quickly enough to protect honest customers and contain unnecessary claims costs.
solution_summary: Zurich Insurance Group runs an in-house AI-assisted fraud detection workflow for claims investigations. In Switzerland, incoming non-life claims from the Allegro core claims system are funneled into Zurich’s proprietary fraud scoring tool, which assigns each claim a 0 to 100 score and flags higher-risk cases for the Special Investigation Unit. The scoring process combines rules with a machine learning model that Zurich describes as natural-language-based generative AI trained to detect words commonly present in fraud cases, initially piloted in German for property and commercial lines. Investigators also use Zurich’s internal AI chatbot in daily work. The solution was built by Zurich Customer Active Management (ZCAM), whose specialists tune the models and workflows with claims teams. The article says claims data is stored using cloud computing, but does not name the storage platform. Outputs are risk scores, anomaly signals, fraud trend insights, and faster routing of suspicious versus honest claims.

data_flow: Claims entered in Allegro are funneled into Zurich Switzerland’s proprietary fraud scoring tool, where rules and a machine learning NLP model analyze claim details and assign a 0 to 100 score. Higher-scoring cases are escalated to the Special Investigation Unit for human investigation, while investigators also use Zurich’s internal AI chatbot in daily work and insights from the system are used to refine future fraud indicators and trend detection.
business_outcome: Zurich says the system reduces false positives, increases the number of suspicious and confirmed fraud cases found, helps the company spot fraud trends earlier, and speeds differentiation between honest and fraudulent claims so legitimate claims can be processed faster. In Brazil, Zurich reports that the fraud detection rate in the affinities business trebled after adopting ZCAM’s system.
